mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market activity that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) indicates supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for supply contraction regime falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP expansion (GDPC1 growth > 0.5%) indicates robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals loss of monetary policy credibility and potential rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% indicates monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC for tightening regime falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
